title: iframe missing sandbox attribute
message: Combining `allow-scripts` & `allow-same-origin` lets the iframe remove its own sandbox, defeating the protection.
help: Add `sandbox=""` or a curated value so embedded pages cannot get full access to your site by default.

title: Locale/timezone formatting during render
message: This can cause a hydration mismatch because toLocaleDateString() formats with the server's locale and timezone during server rendering but the user's in the browser. Format it in a post-mount useEffect, or pass an explicit locale and timeZone.
help: Format locale/timezone-dependent values in a post-mount useEffect + state, or pass an explicit locale and timeZone so the server and the browser render the same text. Only runs on SSR-capable projects.

title: Control missing accessible label
message: Blind users can't tell what this control does because its name is missing or only a symbol, so add visible text, `aria-label`, or `aria-labelledby`.
help: Give every interactive control a label screen readers can read.

title: Data fetching inside an effect
message: fetch() inside useEffect can race, double-fire, or leak. Use a data-fetching layer or Server Component instead.
help: Use a data-fetching layer or Server Component so fetches do not race, double-fire, or leak from `useEffect`.

title: Plain script can block Next.js rendering
message: Plain <script> has no Next.js loading strategy, so it can block rendering.
help: Use `next/script` with `strategy="afterInteractive"` or `"lazyOnload"` so third-party scripts do not block rendering.

title: Render-blocking third-party script
message: This <script> blocks the page from showing to your users until it loads. Add defer or async so it loads in the background.
help: Use `next/script` with `strategy="lazyOnload"`, or add the `defer` attribute.

title: Script without defer or async
message: This blocks the page from loading until the script downloads because <script src> has no defer or async, so add defer for scripts that need the page, or async for standalone ones
help: Add `defer` for scripts that need the page, or `async` for standalone ones like analytics. In Next.js, use `<Script strategy="afterInteractive" />`

message: This effect adjusts state after a prop changes, so users briefly see the stale value.
help: Remove the adjustment effect by deriving values during render, resetting the component with a key, or updating related state in the event that changes the prop.
